name: Colon
description: Large bowel from cecum to rectum: cecum, ascending colon, hepatic flexure, transverse colon, splenic flexure, descending colon, sigmoid colon, rectum. Distinguished from small bowel by haustral folds, taeniae coli, and appendices epiploicae. On CT: assess wall thickness, diverticulosis, masses, and pneumatosis.
